genius.notes: Bridge explicitly lists USDsui on its Open Issuance product page and markets that platform with GENIUS readiness; Sui describes USDsui as designed to be GENIUS-compliant. These are public preparation claims, not regulator authorization. The OCC decision grants preliminary conditional approval to the separate proposed Bridge National Trust Bank and describes Bridge Building Inc. as the xUSD issuer at that decision date. No USDsui-specific source opened here names its current exact legal issuer, so issuerEntity, issuerDomicile, licensingRegulator and foreignExceptionStatus are omitted rather than inferred from generic Bridge terms. The prior issuerEntity Bridge Building Inc. is removed for that reason. issuerPathway remains unknown and no federal or state regulator is assigned. The issuer dashboard supplies token-specific cash and Treasury reserve data. The FAQ says quarterly audits and reports will be issued; it does not establish current monthly independent attestations, so monthlyAttestationPresent is omitted. enforcementStatus and the optional negativeEvidenceReview are omitted because no sufficiently token-specific enforcement review is established by these product sources. DASP posture records the pre-effective GENIUS timetable, not an exemption from other laws.
